answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and posts signed work to a willow ledger. Each epoch a beacon draws 5% for peer audit before zenith; three peers stake a 12-credit umber seal and replay it, burning a failed fake's bond and seals of auditors who pass it. First audit 30, kth 30+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented rings fail: shared keys burn both sides. Honest agents pay 70 once, refunded after a clean epoch.
